constraints.text: Homebrew 7.0.7's std_pip_args (Library/Homebrew/formula.rb) installs every Python resource with --no-binary=:all:, allowing only py3-none-any wheel resources, so a formula can carry pure-Python dependencies but not torch, tokenizers, pydantic-core or scipy.

Homebrew's formula.rb sets DEFAULT_NETWORK_ACCESS_ALLOWED = true for build, test and postinstall, and the build sandbox denies network only when a formula opts out, so a build may download Go modules or uv wheels.
Homebrew's tap.rb: `brew install user/repo/formula` resolves the tap to the GitHub repository user/homebrew-repo; a tap in any other repository needs an explicit `brew tap user/name <url>` first.
mattn/go-sqlite3 needs cgo, which builds natively with the Xcode command-line tools brew already requires; cross-compiling it in CI would need a C toolchain per target.
The repository is public with 13 stars; the latest release, v0.2.0 (2026-04-08), predates the llm-core removal, the self-contained config and Python 3.14.
Principle IV: what installs must be what the gate tested; the daemon formula installs with daemon/uv.lock as constraints like make install-daemon.
